mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the 3-month Treasury yield (measured by GDPC1) over the next month signals a flattening yield curve, which lowers discount rates and increases the present value of future equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in flattening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation rate above 0.2% signals a break in the Fed's 2% target, prompting a preemptive rate hike by the market, which compresses discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in inflation spikes are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in PAYEMS employment exceeds 2% for three consecutive months, indicating a strengthening labor market that supports wage growth and corporate earnings momentum, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
